title: How a Godly Man Handles the Urge He Gave Into Last Time
caption:
How a godly man handles the urge he gave into last time.

God already knows it's coming back tonight. This time you get to answer differently.

Name the urge specifically instead of calling it "struggling." Change the room before you try to change your mind. Call the brother before you fall, not after. Christ set you free to stand firm, not to perform a comeback (Galatians 5:1).

You don't need a testimony tonight. You need one no.

#faith #selfcontrol #christianmen #manofgod #purity #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
